equal_location_weighting.interpretation: The negative activity direction remains when repeated deployments are collapsed to equal-weight physical locations. The frozen deployment-weighted E4 score is not replaced by this post-result reaggregation.

leave_one_location_out.interpretation: No single physical location is sufficient to determine the negative aggregate activity direction, although location domains strongly determine its magnitude.

source_domain_magnitude.interpretation: The sign is not unique to the D-prefixed source domain, but almost all of the aggregate loss magnitude is. Excluding source strata after seeing the outcome is diagnostic only and cannot redefine the frozen E4 endpoint.

supported: The E4 activity-transfer failure is not an artifact of counting repeated deployments from one physical location as independent rows: equal-location weighting remains negative.
The activity direction is not controlled by one single location: every leave-one-location-out deployment-weighted mean remains negative.
The negative direction extends beyond the dominant D-prefixed source domain because 11 of 12 non-D event-bearing locations also have negative location-mean activity gain.

The magnitude of the failure remains strongly source-domain concentrated: removing the D-prefixed stratum descriptively reduces the remaining deployment-weighted mean activity gain to approximately -0.0031.
not_supported: Replacing the frozen 733-deployment E4 endpoint with an equal-location endpoint.
A causal location, country, observer, camera, or source-network effect.
A universal claim that activity information is harmful.
Rerunning, retuning, backend switching, or Laplace/INLA authorization.
